name: moh731V2023DsdEstablishedBase
description: MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) 3.5 Differentiated Service Delivery, HV03-033 Established and HV03-034 Not Established: the clients of the earlier O3 dataset establishedBase3X (active and on ART this month, as 3.2), with stability read from amrs.obs at the client's clinical encounter -- the latest non-voided 12108 (stability) and 12127 obs, one each, rather than from etl.flat_obs -- with the figure's flag named as its indicator and the client's name, identifiers and location for the linelist. For the Summary only, the clients are also split three ways that never overlap and together are every client on ART (3.2): established, not_established_recorded (recorded as not established, and not as established), and dsd_not_categorized (no stability recorded, or a value that is neither) -- the form's not_established counts the last two together. It also carries each client's latest DSD model (moh731V2023DsdLatestObs, classified by the HV03-035/036 rules, with Standard care (10989) and Fast track care (10990) also counted as facility), split into dsd_community_on_art, dsd_facility_on_art and dsd_model_not_categorized (no model recorded at the locations, or one that is neither). These never overlap and together are every client on ART (3.2). The form's community / facility figures count anyone whose latest model is recorded there, on ART or not.

join.joinCondition: stab.obs_id = (SELECT MAX(o.obs_id) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = fhs.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 12108 AND o.voided = 0)
nes.obs_id = (SELECT MAX(o.obs_id) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = fhs.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 12127 AND o.voided = 0)
pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = fr.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)
mob_cn.concept_id = IF(mob.concept_id = 10988, mob.value_coded, mob.concept_id) AND mob_cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND mob_cn.voided = 0

expressionOptions.expression: IF((stab.obs_id IS NOT NULL OR nes.obs_id IS NOT NULL), IF(COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 1, 1, NULL), 1)
IF(COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 1, 1, NULL)
IF(COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 0, 1, NULL)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = fr.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = fr.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 45 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

CASE WHEN COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12106, 0) = 1 THEN 'Established' WHEN COALESCE(stab.value_coded = 12107 OR nes.value_coded IN (9070, 12266), 0) = 1 THEN 'Not established' ELSE 'Not categorized' END

IF(COALESCE(mob.concept_id = 11932 OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11932) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 10993) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11937) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11936), 0), 1, NULL)

IF(COALESCE(mob.concept_id = 11932 OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11932) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 10993) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11937) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11936), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(mob.concept_id = 11931 OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11931) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 10991) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 10992) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11940) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded = 11938) OR (mob.concept_id = 10988 and mob.value_coded IN (10989, 10990)), 0) = 0, 1, NULL)
